provider.notes: Canonical id and aliases come from the plugin registry (gateway/src/plugin/builtin/mod.rs:1768-1771). The standardized factory that live sessions use accepts only alibaba-cloud and alibaba_cloud (gateway/src/core/stt/standard.rs:400-402). default_model is the client constant DEFAULT_STT_MODEL (gateway/src/core/stt/alibaba_cloud/config.rs:48); its row's only usable transport is today's client, which is recorded as known broken, so a default-configured session keeps that client and the defect is reported in ready.stt. The server has no API-key mapping for this provider (gateway/src/config/mod.rs:679 is the 'Unsupported provider' fall-through), so a session must supply its own key. This file has 50 rows: 41 exact rows keyed by the vendor's wire id, eight pattern rows and the provider default. (1) Model-string rewriting. Before dialing, the client rewrites ten strings (config.rs:164-176). The five that are not vendor ids (qwen3-asr, qwen-asr, paraformer, paraformer-8k, funasr) are model_aliases on the rows of the models the client dials instead. The other five (paraformer-v2, paraformer-8k-v2, paraformer-v1, paraformer-8k-v1, fun-asr) are vendor ids of asynchronous file models; their rows record the streaming model the client substitutes and are refused from Release 3, default on. If the rewrite is removed from the client, those rows need no change. None of the ten is advertised: the plugin metadata lists only qwen3-asr-flash-realtime, paraformer-realtime-v2, paraformer-realtime-8k-v2 and fun-asr-realtime (gateway/src/plugin/builtin/mod.rs:406-411). (2) No model check. Any other string becomes Custom and is sent to the streaming inference socket (config.rs:176, :707-717). (3) Regions. Model availability differs between Singapore, Beijing and US (Virginia), keys are bound to a region, and the client always dials the Beijing legacy host (config.rs:574) unless an endpoint override is set; US (Virginia) has no legacy host. The vendor states that the legacy DashScope domain, the only one the client knows, gets no new features after 2026-09-30. The file transports that the fact-check placed carry region constraints; the streaming rows name their regions in provenance notes only, because a constraint on a row's only usable transport would leave an excluded session without an answer. (4) Retirements. Thirteen ids retire on 2026-10-10 (ten dated snapshots, and the undated fun-asr-mtl, fun-asr-mtl-realtime and sensevoice-v1), including every snapshot behind the default model and behind qwen3-asr-flash. Their rows are 'deprecated' today and carry recheck_on; on that date each must become 'retired' with an empty transports list, and the stable aliases, which carry the same recheck date, must be re-read. (5) Family patterns. The vendor's catalogue lists each model id under exactly one interface: a streaming id sent to the file endpoint is expected to fail, and so is the reverse (inferred from the catalogue; no live call was made). Eight pattern rows therefore sit between the exact rows and the provider default and follow the vendor's naming, as the audit inferred it: an id containing -realtime, -asr-flash-streaming or -asr-flash-message is a streaming socket model; an id containing -filetrans, or a dated fun-asr-202... snapshot, is an asynchronous job with no live path; a dated qwen3-asr-flash-2... or fun-asr-flash-2... snapshot is a synchronous file model. All eight are marked 'assumed'. Each pattern has a different number of literal characters, so precedence between them never depends on file order. The vendor has three model classes: streaming socket models, synchronous short-file models (the ones that need segmentation, served by the regional REST adapter in Release 5, wider vendor coverage and hardening, after a live probe), and asynchronous URL-only jobs (no live path).

gateway_client.defect: The gateway's Qwen realtime client does not match the vendor's documented protocol. The vendor's final-transcript event carries emotion as a plain string; the client declares it as an object, so the event fails to parse and the transcript is dropped (found by reading the types and the vendor page, not executed). The session.update message also differs from the documented shape. Correct the parser and add a unit test with the vendor's sample event before enabling.
gateway_client.code_ref: gateway/src/core/stt/alibaba_cloud/client.rs:477-496 (session.update), :523-550 (result handling); gateway/src/core/stt/alibaba_cloud/messages.rs:85-109, :222-224, :238-246; gateway/src/core/stt/alibaba_cloud/config.rs:181-186
gateway_client.notes: Protocol: session.update on /api-ws/v1/realtime?model=<id>, base64 audio appends, vendor voice detection ends each utterance. Evidence of the mismatch: emotion is declared as {tag, confidence} (messages.rs:222-224, :238-246) while the vendor sends a string; a parse failure is only logged (client.rs:546-548); no test fixture contains emotion. session.update nests sample_rate under input_audio_transcription (vendor: session.sample_rate), defaults the threshold to 0.5 (vendor 0.2) and announces manual mode as type 'manual' (vendor: turn_detection null) (messages.rs:85-109, client.rs:477-496). provenance.notes: Provider default. Today's client is listed first, as on every row whose native client works: an id the client does not know becomes Custom and is sent a run-task on the inference socket (config.rs:176, :707-717), which is what a session naming it gets today. The file upload stays second and is chosen only with transcription_mode segmented once its adapter is enabled. For this vendor the id itself usually reveals the interface (inferred by the audit from the vendor's naming), and the catalogue lists each id under one interface only, so a streaming id uploaded as a file is expected to fail, and the reverse too (inferred; no live call was made). The pattern rows above this one therefore catch ids that contain -realtime, -asr-flash-streaming, -asr-flash-message or -filetrans and the dated snapshots of qwen3-asr-flash, fun-asr-flash and fun-asr. What reaches this row is an id with none of those markers; in the vendor's catalogue such an id is either a synchronous file model (qwen3-asr-flash, qwen-audio-3.x-asr-flash) or an asynchronous one (fun-asr, paraformer-v2, sensevoice-v1), and the file transport assumes the first. The gateway's shorthand strings no longer reach this row: they are model_aliases on the rows of the models the client rewrites them to (config.rs:164-176).
